problem:
The row echelon form matrix $A$ is given below. What are its **non**-pivot columns?

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 3 & 0 & 5 \\ 0 & -3 & 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & -1 & -8 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}]
$$
worked_solution:
Remember that the pivots of a matrix in row echelon form are the first non-zero entries in each row of the matrix.

We can see that $A$ has $3$ pivots in the $1$st, $2$nd and $4$th columns:

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 3 & 0 & 5 \\ 0 & -3 & 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & -1 & -8 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}]
$$

Therefore, the only non-pivot columns are the $3$rd and $5$th columns.
